## Checklist

- [ ] This PR targets **`staging`** (release PRs from `staging` → `main` are the exception)
- [ ] The title follows Conventional Commits, e.g. `feat(catch-log): add offline queue`
- [ ] The change is focused on one issue — no unrelated reformatting
- [ ] No secrets, API keys, `.env` files, or real personal data are committed
- [ ] Documentation and `.env.example` updated if the change requires it
- [ ] Tests added or updated for behaviour changes
- [ ] I have reviewed my own diff, line by line
- [ ] I have read the [Contributing guide](https://github.com/Swahilipot-Hub-Engineering/.github/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
